scale-converter.name: Scale Converter
scale-converter.intro: Convert between map distance and ground distance using a scale ratio such as 1:1000.

leveling-calc.name: Leveling Adjustment Calculator
leveling-calc.intro: Reduce a leveling run and distribute the closing error across stations by distance or number of setups.

coordinate-convert.name: Coordinate Converter
coordinate-convert.intro: Convert survey points between coordinate systems such as geographic, plane and local grid.

convert-46.name: Latitude/Longitude to DMS Converter
convert-46.intro: Convert decimal-degree coordinates to degrees-minutes-seconds (DMS) and back.

convert-angle-slope-1.name: Slope Percent to Angle Converter
convert-angle-slope-1.intro: Convert a slope between percent grade and angle in degrees.

convert-33.name: Total Station Slope/Horizontal/Height Converter
convert-33.intro: Convert a total station slope distance to horizontal distance and elevation difference using the vertical angle.

calc-1.name: Leveling Network Adjustment
calc-1.intro: Adjust a leveling network and distribute misclosure across lines by weight.

area-calc.name: Area Calculator
area-calc.intro: Compute the area of common plane figures from measured dimensions.

calc-86.name: Road Centerline and Cross-section Calculator
calc-86.intro: Compute road centerline, cross-section and staking data for route design.

calc-angle-2.name: Angle Measurement Calculator
calc-angle-2.intro: Compute angles from measured directions and reduce them to observed values.

distance-calc.name: Distance Calculator
distance-calc.intro: Compute horizontal distance and slope corrections from survey observations.

assessor-16.name: GPS Accuracy (PDOP) Assessor
assessor-16.intro: Assess GPS positioning accuracy from PDOP, HDOP and VDOP values and the number of visible satellites.

grade-angle.name: Angle to Percent Grade Converter
grade-angle.intro: Convert between slope angle in degrees and percent grade.

elevation-diff.name: Closed Leveling Loop
elevation-diff.intro: Compute height differences and misclosure around a closed leveling loop.

bearing-to-offset.name: Coordinate Increment from Distance and Bearing
bearing-to-offset.intro: Compute the coordinate increments (ΔN, ΔE) from a distance and a bearing.

earthwork-pyramid-volume.name: Pyramid Volume from Base Area and Height
earthwork-pyramid-volume.intro: Compute the volume of a pyramid-shaped earthwork from base area and height.

external-distance-curve.name: External Distance from Radius and Deflection Angle
external-distance-curve.intro: Compute the external distance of a circular curve from its radius and deflection angle.

end-area-volume.name: Earthwork Volume from Two End Areas
end-area-volume.intro: Compute earthwork volume between two cross-sections from their end areas and spacing.

middle-ordinate-curve.name: Middle Ordinate from Radius and Deflection
middle-ordinate-curve.intro: Compute the middle ordinate of a circular curve from its radius and deflection angle.

tangent-length-curve.name: Tangent Length from Radius and Deflection
tangent-length-curve.intro: Compute the tangent length of a circular curve from its radius and deflection angle.

chord-length-curve.name: Chord Length from Radius and Deflection
chord-length-curve.intro: Compute the long chord length of a circular curve from its radius and deflection angle.

horizontal-from-slope.name: Horizontal Distance from Slope Distance and Vertical Angle
horizontal-from-slope.intro: Compute the horizontal distance from a slope distance and a vertical angle.

subtense-distance.name: Distance from Subtense Bar and Angle
subtense-distance.intro: Compute distance to a subtense bar from its length and the subtended angle.

coordinate-distance-3d.name: 3D Distance Between Two Points
coordinate-distance-3d.intro: Compute the spatial (3D) distance between two points from their coordinates.

analysis-cycle.name: Deformation Monitoring Chart
analysis-cycle.intro: Chart deformation monitoring cycles and analyze movement trends over time.

vertical-curve-elev.name: Parabolic Vertical Curve
vertical-curve-elev.intro: Compute elevations along a parabolic vertical curve for road design.

bearing-from-coordinates.name: Bearing from Two Coordinates
bearing-from-coordinates.intro: Compute the bearing (azimuth) between two points from their coordinates.

reduced-level-bsfs.name: Reduced Level from Cumulative BS/FS
reduced-level-bsfs.intro: Compute reduced levels by the rise-and-fall or height-of-instrument method from cumulative backsight and foresight readings.

cut-fill-volume.name: Volume Between Adjacent Cross-sections
cut-fill-volume.intro: Compute cut-and-fill volume between adjacent cross-sections.

area-24.name: Cadastral Survey Calculator
area-24.intro: Compute parcel boundary, area and ownership data for cadastral surveying.

area-25.name: Real Estate Survey Calculator
area-25.intro: Compute floor area, title and cadastral data for real estate surveying.

coordinate-distance-2d.name: Horizontal Distance from Two Plan Coordinates
coordinate-distance-2d.intro: Compute the horizontal distance between two points from their plane coordinates.

prismoidal-volume.name: Prismoidal Volume from Two Ends and Mid Area
prismoidal-volume.intro: Compute volume by the prismoidal formula from two end areas and the mid-area.

bearing-azimuth.name: Azimuth from Coordinate Increments
bearing-azimuth.intro: Compute the azimuth (bearing) from coordinate increments Δx and Δy.

grade-intersection-elev.name: Elevation on Vertical Curve from Grade and Length
grade-intersection-elev.intro: Compute the elevation at any point on a vertical curve from the grade and curve length.

slope-percent.name: Longitudinal Grade Calculator
slope-percent.intro: Compute longitudinal grade as height difference divided by horizontal distance.

horizontal-distance.name: Slope Distance to Horizontal Distance
horizontal-distance.intro: Convert a measured slope distance to horizontal distance.

circular-curve.name: Circular Curve Elements
circular-curve.intro: Compute the main elements (tangent, curve, chord, external, middle ordinate) of a circular curve.

analysis-17.name: Buffer (Radius) Analysis
analysis-17.intro: Generate buffer zones around points, lines or polygons by a given radius and analyze the covered area.

area-coordinates.name: Polygon Closed Area
area-coordinates.intro: Compute the closed area of a polygon from its vertex coordinates (shoelace formula).

coordinate-rotation.name: Rotate Plan Point about Origin
coordinate-rotation.intro: Rotate a plan point about the origin by a given angle.

triangulation-side.name: Side by Law of Sines
triangulation-side.intro: Compute an unknown side of a triangle using the law of sines.

stadia-distance.name: Stadia Distance Calculator
stadia-distance.intro: Compute distance and elevation by the stadia interval method from rod readings.

distance-4.name: Distance Corrections Calculator
distance-4.intro: Apply slope, temperature and sea-level corrections to measured distances.
